howToVerify.text: Work through the hypotheses, none of which is a diagnosis: 1. Shipping cost at checkout may be higher than expected. findings.title: Product View → Add to Cart: investigate the drop-off

facts.text: This step loses the largest share in the funnel — 71.89% of 1,825 sessions. Its conversion is within threshold, so this is about volume rather than underperformance.

whyPriority.text: Ranked High: rule severity High, evidence sufficient, 1,825 sessions that entered this step, 1,312 lost.

howToVerify.text: Work through the hypotheses, none of which is a diagnosis: 1. Price may be out of line with what comparable products ask. Compare price against the alternatives a shopper would see in the same search. 2. The page may not make the case for the product in concrete terms. Check whether the first screen states weight, capacity, rating or whatever the category buys on. 3. Absent or thin reviews may leave the claim unsupported. Check review count and recency against the better-converting products. 4. The add-to-cart control may be unclear or below the fold. View the page at mobile width and confirm the action is visible without scrolling. 5. Images may not show the product in use, at scale or in detail. Compare the image set against what the category leaders show, including scale references. 6. Delivery cost and timing may not be visible before the cart. Check whether shipping cost and delivery estimate appear on the product page itself.

whyPriority.text: 自然搜索访客在加入购物车后至结账环节流失明显，直接限制购买完成。

howToVerify.text: 逐项检查可能性，但不要将其视为诊断：加入购物车后，确认无需寻找即可看到前往结账的路径。对照商品页价格与购物车小计中的运费和税费。加入商品后离开并稍后返回，确认购物车仍被保留。

findings.ruleGuidance: Work through the hypotheses, none of which is a diagnosis: 1. Adding to cart may not make the next step obvious, leaving people stalled. Add an item and confirm the path to checkout is visible without hunting for it. 2. Costs first revealed at the cart may be causing people to reconsider. Compare the price shown on the product page against the cart subtotal including shipping and tax. 3. Carts may not survive a return visit, so intent is lost between sessions. Add an item, leave, return later and confirm the cart is still there.
